entities.summary: Nobutada Saji  is a Japanese businessman, chief executive of Suntory Ltd, the world's third-largest distiller behind such brands such as Jim Beam and Maker's Mark as well as brewer and food manufacturer. He has a net worth of over a billion dollars.
